children.name: Coldenia nuttallii Benth.
children.description: A synonym of the accepted Tiquilia nuttallii (family Ehretiaceae/Boraginaceae, order Boraginales), a low-growing annual to subshrub-like herb seldom over 10-30 cm tall, with small ridged (crinkled) leaves and five-lobed flowers. It occurs across western North America from central Washington to western Colorado and northern California and Arizona, in middle- and higher-elevation deserts. NatureServe: Secure.

children.name: Coldenia virens S.Watson, 1895
children.description: A species of Coldenia (Boraginaceae s.l.) described in 1895 from Chile. It is currently an unresolved name, treated by Plants of the World Online as an unplaced name (neither accepted nor placed in synonymy) and listed as unchecked in World Flora Online; no reliable morphological description is available on authoritative sources.
